expected.title: voidInvoice has no authorize() so any signed-in user can void invoices
expected.rationale: Authorisation missing on a mutating procedure is the S0 definition (security failure, access-rule violation) and control SEC-API-01. Tenant context is present, so RUB-SEC-02 is n/a.

notes: Also acceptable: a question on whether the procedure is intentionally public; not acceptable: S1 because it is only one procedure.
